headline: China's culture ministry approves 14 AI application pilots across culture and tourism
summary: China's Ministry of Culture and Tourism published an approved roster of 14 AI+culture-and-tourism pilot projects. The official attachment names implementing and recommending units and groups projects across six directions, including cultural production, public services, heritage protection, tourism formats and services, and market supervision. Named implementers include national cultural organizations, universities, public bodies and companies. The document records project approvals; it gives no funding, milestones, technical specifications or outcomes, so it does not establish that systems have been deployed or produced measurable benefits.
